summaries.en: The Democratic Party's election committee decided to re-discuss and likely reduce the quadrupled deposit fee for youth candidates in the upcoming party convention, following widespread criticism from party leader Lee Jae-myung and other members.
summaries.zh: 民主党选举管理委员会因将党代会青年候选人保证金提高四倍而遭到党首李在明等党内外人士的强烈批评后，决定重新讨论并可能减轻青年候选人的经济负担。
